local p = {}

-- {{Div|em=0.5|first|second|third|...}}  ->  a flex row of <div>s that wraps when it is too wide.
-- Reads the arguments of the template that called it, so there is no limit on how many you give.
function p.row(frame)
	local args = frame:getParent().args

	-- gap between the boxes, in em (default 0.5)
	local gap = tonumber(mw.text.trim(args.em or ''))
	if not gap or gap < 0 then gap = 0.5 end

	-- collect the numbered arguments in order (1, 2, 3 ...)
	local keys = {}
	for k in pairs(args) do
		if type(k) == 'number' then keys[#keys + 1] = k end
	end
	table.sort(keys)

	local root = mw.html.create('div')
		:css('display', 'flex')
		:css('gap', gap .. 'em')
		:css('flex-wrap', 'wrap')
	local any = false
	for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
		local v = args[k]
		if mw.text.trim(v) ~= '' then   -- empty arguments do not make an empty box
			root:tag('div'):wikitext(v)
			any = true
		end
	end
	if not any then return '' end
	return tostring(root)
end

return p
